title: SponsorBar
brief: macOS menu-bar app by Henry Kutrieb that displays a small sponsor slot in your menu bar and shares ad revenue with users.
details: An X announcement of SponsorBar — a small app that puts an ad in your menu bar and shares the revenue with you ("make money from your menu bar for doing nothing"), with a 10%-extra launch promo. A real launched product, though a niche one. The link is the announcement post. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
